shunt_ohms.description: Actual shunt resistance in ohms, positive and finite. Use the calibrated physical value; max_current_a * shunt_ohms must fit the selected ADC range.

max_current_a.description: Positive calibration full-scale current in A, not an actuator current limit. The driver derives CURRENT_LSB/SHUNT_CAL, validates representability and uses the effective quantized calibration.

adc_range.description: 0: ±163.84 mV shunt range; 1: ±40.96 mV range. max_current_a * shunt_ohms must not exceed the selected full scale.

Ina228Configuration.description: INA228 shunt calibration for direct ESP I2C. Use endpoint 64..79 (decimal address) and explicitly approved pins [SDA, SCL]; I2C0 instances share the same pin pair and need unique addresses. Voltage/current/power, epoch-relative energy/charge and internal die temperature use the common sensor API. Hardware accuracy commissioning remains open.
